text: エスパーに　ゆうりな　もの？

structure.jp: エスパーに　ゆうりな　もの？
structure.en: something with an advantage against Psychic?

patterns.name: 〜に (target)
patterns.span: エスパーに　ゆうりな
patterns.explanation: に shows who or what something is aimed at; with ゆうり it tells you who the advantage is against. エスパーに　ゆうりな　もの = 'things that have the edge on Psychic'.
